trick.text: Vapor pressure and boiling point have an inverse relationship.

steps: Polar X and nonpolar Y attract each other **weakly**.
Mixed attractions are weaker than in either pure liquid.
Vapor pressure rises above ideal: positive deviation.
Higher vapor pressure means a lower boiling point.

traps.A: Negative deviation needs stronger mixed attractions.
traps.C: Polar and nonpolar liquids do not mix ideally.
traps.D: Only one deviation applies.
traps.E: Nothing here fixes an azeotrope at 1:1.
